name: Material Icon Theme
description: File icons from Material Icon Theme 5.38.1 for the file tree, editor tabs, breadcrumbs, Quick Open and every other file list. Off by default: enable it to replace the built-in file glyphs, disable it to restore them.

headless.reason: File icons are an appearance contribution and need an interactive shell.
